name: Nagao Wetland Fund

funder.name: Nagao Natural Environment Foundation and the Ramsar Convention Secretariat

summary: Annual small grants of up to US$30,000 for wetland conservation and wise use projects in selected developing countries of Asia and Oceania, each needing endorsement from the country's Ramsar focal point.

geography.label: Target countries of the 2026 call in Asia and Oceania

eligibility.rule: Project has signed endorsement from the Convention's Administrative Authority head or National Focal Point

status.quote: Application Open from 31 March to 30 June 2026 (23:00 CEST).

opens.quote: Application Open from 31 March to 30 June 2026 (23:00 CEST).

deadline.quote: Application Open from 31 March to 30 June 2026 (23:00 CEST).

geography.quote: The target countries for this call are as follows: Bangladesh, Bhutan, Cambodia, Indonesia, Iraq, Jordan, Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan, Lao People's Democratic Republic, Lebanon, Malaysia, Mongolia, Myanmar, Nepal, Philippines, Sri Lanka, Syrian Arab Republic, Tajikistan, Thailand, Turkmenistan, Uzbekistan, Viet Nam, Yemen, Fiji, Kiribati, Marshall Islands, Palau, Papua New Guinea, Samoa, Vanuatu.

access.quote: Formal submission of projects must be made online by the deadline established in Annex I.

window.quote: Each year, the Secretariat will make an announcement on their website and notify the Administrative Authority of the eligible Contracting Parties.

effort.quote: Application Open from 31 March to 30 June 2026 (23:00 CEST).

eligibility.quote: Any proposal without the signed endorsement of the head of the Administrative Authority or the National Focal Point of the Convention will not be accepted.

after_award.quote: Each recipient agency is required to provide a Progress Technical and Financial Report on the implementation of NWF-funded projects by the end of the sixth month since the start date of the project and a Final Report within two months of project competition
